OnPlay.issue: C# applies the debuff unconditionally and the only gate is `Creature.CanReceivePowers` (Creature.cs:308-321), whose doc comment states that DEAD creatures can still receive powers -- it refuses only for a REMOVED corpse. The two agree for an ordinary kill (`CreatureCmd.Damage` runs `Kill` before returning, CreatureCmd.cs:409, removal at 523-525) and diverge for a corpse whose removal was VETOED (`ShouldCreatureBeRemovedFromCombatAfterDeath`, CreatureCmd.cs:508; the sim's `retained_after_death`, cmds.py:100-104), because `is_gone` is `is_dead or escaped` (creatures.py:44-46). Observable through ViciousPower, which draws on any Vulnerable its owner applies with no liveness test on the target (ViciousPower.cs:19-26). Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bash's OnPlay entry (rule 3); LIVE. EXECUTED: `py audit/tools/card_probes.py dead-target-guards` lists 41 sim card classes that test liveness. Damage 10 first, then Vulnerable 2 -- amounts and order faithful (Squash.cs:32-35). Presentation, folded in: WithHitFx and the Vulnerable hover tip.
